problem.title: Before solving anything, customers must reach the right information
problem.body: The friction is not only the technical issue. It is everything that happens before it reaches a specialist.

items.title: Poor product identification
items.description: Incomplete Part Numbers, applications or OEM references lead to slow lookups and wrong replacements.

items.title: Disconnected channels
items.description: Catalogue, manuals, diagnosis and requests live in different places with no continuity.

items.title: Low visibility
items.description: Neither customer nor team can see history or request status in real time.

items.title: Triage rework
items.description: Requests arrive without photos, symptoms or equipment data, causing back-and-forth.

solution.title: One front door for technical after-sales
solution.body: An installable web app (PWA), built for the phone in the workshop and the desktop in the office. Every card below opens the real feature.

items.title: Scan and identify
items.description: QR code or Part Number open the right technical sheet, no sign-in needed.

items.title: Searchable catalogue
items.description: Search by application, vehicle maker, OEM or technical feature.

items.title: Guided diagnosis
items.description: Step-by-step help for the most frequent issues before raising a request.

items.title: Context-rich request
items.description: Product, symptoms, equipment, location and attachments reach support together.

items.title: Service desk and technicians
items.description: Queue, priority, escalation to technicians, visits and reports.

items.title: Built for 3 languages
items.description: Portuguese, Spanish and English in sync across the interface.

journey.title: One request, one history, as many levels as needed
journey.body: Customers solve simple cases on their own. Everything else reaches a specialist with full information.

steps.title: Identify
steps.description: QR code, Part Number or catalogue search.

steps.title: Consult
steps.description: Technical sheet, manuals, videos and frequent issues.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.description: A guided checklist solves simple cases without a request.

steps.title: Open request
steps.description: A wizard captures product, symptoms, photos and location.

steps.title: Handle
steps.description: Support takes ownership and, if needed, calls a technician or visit.

steps.title: Record
steps.description: The documented solution feeds the knowledge base.

journey.publicText: Products, catalogue, manuals and diagnosis need no account: any mechanic can look things up instantly.
journey.protectedText: Requests, attachments, history and company data are isolated per organisation (Row Level Security).

demo.title: Try it now, as any profile
demo.body: The prototype works end to end. Sign in with one click as customer, support, technician or manager and follow the same request across the operation.
demo.note: Demo mode: data is stored only in this browser.

pilot.title: Controlled pilot proposal
pilot.body: Validate with real users before scaling. Benefits are hypotheses the pilot must measure against an agreed baseline.
